# Quickstart

Get from zero to a first request in five minutes. {/* TODO: screenshot */}

<Callout type="warning" title="Before you start">
  You need an API key. Create one under **Settings → Keys**.
</Callout>

## Install

<Tabs>
  <TabItem value="npm" label="npm">
    ```bash
    npm install @acme/sdk
    ```
  </TabItem>
  <TabItem value="pnpm" label="pnpm">
    ```bash
    pnpm add @acme/sdk
    ```
  </TabItem>
</Tabs>

## Send a request

<Steps>
  <Step title="Create a client">
    Pass the key from the environment, never inline.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Call the API">
    ```ts title="index.ts"
    const res = await client.ping();
    ```
  </Step>
</Steps>

<CodeGroup>
```bash curl
curl https://api.acme.dev/v1/ping -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
```

```python Python
client.ping()
```
</CodeGroup>

:::tip[Faster local runs]
Set `ACME_CACHE=1` to reuse responses.
:::

<Card title="API reference" href="https://docs.acme.dev/api">
  Every endpoint, with examples.
</Card>

Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>C</kbd> to stop. The current value is {props.value}.

<Accordion title="Troubleshooting">
  - Check the key has the `read` scope.
  - Retry after a `429`.
</Accordion>
